name: ATIS-NVAF
fullName: Optimal Antithrombotics for Ischemic Stroke and Concurrent Atrial Fibrillation and Atherosclerosis: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
population: n=316, Mean 77.2 years, NIHSS Not specified in reviewed abstract, Stroke/TIA 8–360 days before enrollment; two-year outcome
teachingPoint: Supports caution about routine combined antiplatelet and anticoagulant therapy solely for coexisting atherosclerosis after stroke. It does not establish absence of benefit for every separate antiplatelet indication.

name: MATCH
fullName: Aspirin and Clopidogrel Compared with Clopidogrel Alone after Recent Ischaemic Stroke or TIA in High-Risk Patients
population: n=7599, adults, NIHSS recent ischemic stroke or TIA plus ≥1 additional vascular risk factor, 18 months of treatment and follow-up
teachingPoint: Adding aspirin to clopidogrel for 18 months after stroke/TIA gave no significant benefit and doubled life-threatening bleeding.
